summary: P1 Polish Hardening Tests - Iteration 213. Validated entitlements API 401 behavior for unauthenticated requests, payment page responsive layouts, app-readiness route, and premium hook signed-out state behavior. All 15 backend tests passed. All frontend tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: VERIFIED: GET /api/payments/entitlements returns 401 for unauthenticated requests (no cookies/headers)
VERIFIED: GET /api/payments/entitlements returns valid schema with has_subscription, has_full_app_unlock, sections, purchased_unlocks when authenticated
VERIFIED: Payment success page loads with proper states (checking, success, failed) and responsive button layout
VERIFIED: Payment cancel page has no horizontal overflow on mobile (tested 320px, 375px, 390px, 414px)
VERIFIED: Payment cancel page buttons stack vertically on mobile viewports
VERIFIED: /app-readiness route loads without top-nav overlap (header at y=0)
VERIFIED: App readiness checklist interaction works (checkbox toggle updates progress)
VERIFIED: Premium hook correctly resets entitlements to default state after logout (401 from API)
VERIFIED: Breathwork page shows premium lock indicators for signed-out users
VERIFIED: Logout invalidates session and subsequent entitlements call returns 401
context_for_next_testing_agent: P1 polish hardening complete. Entitlements API now correctly returns 401 for unauthenticated requests (fixed from previous iteration where it returned 200 with empty data). Payment pages have proper responsive layouts with no horizontal overflow. App readiness page has no top-nav overlap. Premium hook correctly handles signed-out state.

entitlements_unauth_401.details: GET /api/payments/entitlements returns 401 with 'Not authenticated' detail for unauthenticated requests

entitlements_auth_schema.details: Authenticated entitlements returns has_subscription, has_full_app_unlock, sections (premium_breathwork, rose_temple, healing_portals), purchased_unlocks

payment_success_responsive.details: Payment success page buttons stack vertically on mobile, no horizontal overflow

payment_cancel_responsive.details: Payment cancel page buttons stack vertically on mobile at all tested widths (320-414px), no horizontal overflow

app_readiness_no_overlap.details: /app-readiness header starts at y=0, no top-nav overlap regression

app_readiness_checklist.details: Checklist checkbox interaction works, progress updates correctly

premium_hook_signout.details: After logout, entitlements API returns 401, premium hook resets to default state with all sections locked
